title: Yellow fever in Cameroon
summary: The Ministry of Health of Cameroon carried out a yellow fever mass vaccination campaign with a reported 94% coverage of the targeted population of 663 900 in 13 health districts considered to be at high risk of yellow fever.

title: Wild poliovirus in the Horn of Africa – update
summary: Three suspected cases of wild poliovirus type 1 (WPV1) from South Sudan are currently being investigated.  All three patients are girls, two of whom are approximately  two-years-old and one is eight-years-old.   All had previously been  immunized with oral polio vaccine (OPV).
